title: Legora appoints Erika Fisher as its first Chief Legal Officer
summary: Legora appoints Erika Fisher as its first Chief Legal Officer
body_markdown:
Erika Fisher joins from HubSpot, where she was Chief Legal Officer, and previously held C-Suite legal and operating roles at Atlassian. She will lead Legora's legal function as the company continues to scale rapidly, currently serving more than 2,500 law firms and in-house legal teams across more than 80 markets and growing.


Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced the appointment of Erika Fisher as its first Chief Legal Officer, effective November 16, 2026. Fisher joins from HubSpot, where she led the company's global legal and compliance functions, and will lead Legora's legal function as the company enters its next phase of growth.


Fisher has more than 15 years of experience building and leading in-house legal and operations functions at high-growth technology companies, including nearly a decade in the public company C-Suite. At Atlassian, which she joined in 2016, she held roles including Commercial and Product Counsel and Head of Privacy before becoming Chief Administrative and Legal Officer, overseeing legal, people and talent, real estate, facilities, and customer support, and managing the company's board of directors. She began her career practicing law at Weil, Gotshal & Manges and Goodwin Procter, advising early-stage technology companies on licensing and transactional matters, and served on the board of the Business Software Alliance and as Global Chair of the L-Suite.


"We see legal teams, in-house and at law firms, with more demand than they can meet, and they want to say yes to more of it, with confidence," said **Max Junestrand, CEO and Co-Founder of Legora** . "Erika has been on the buyer's side of that at two global software companies, and she knows what lawyers need from technology to do more in their day. She will make sure Legora keeps building for that."


At HubSpot, Fisher led global legal and compliance with a focus on trust, privacy, and safety in products and customer experiences. At Legora, she will lead the legal function as the company grows and help develop Legora's product for legal teams, with a particular focus on in-house, drawing on her experience as a longtime in-house leader and buyer of AI. Her appointment comes as in-house legal teams, only a small fraction of Legora's customer base a year ago, have grown to more than 40% of new customers in the third quarter. In-house customers include Salesforce, Broadcom and Palo Alto Networks. Legora's governance, access control and auditability are built in, so legal teams can put real work through AI and say yes to more of the business, faster.


"I started my career working alongside founders and technologists, helping them bring ambitious ideas into the world in a trustworthy way that would last. Now some of the world’s best technologists and operators are working alongside the legal profession to bring it into its next chapter as AI unlocks new possibilities. It’s an incredibly exciting time to be a lawyer. And yet, every legal team is deciding how much real work to trust AI with, and the answer depends on how thoughtfully the system around the model is designed: the permissions, the user experience, the audit trail," said **Erika Fisher, Chief Legal Officer at Legora** . "Legora is built around those questions, and I want to help legal teams adopt it with confidence."


Fisher added, "I'm excited about what Legora can do for the whole profession. This technology can move lawyers up the value chain and amplify the craft of the work, from junior associates to general counsel. I'll bring my perspective as a buyer and operator to help build it."


Fisher will be based in New York and will report to Max Junestrand, CEO and Co-Founder of Legora.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
